articles.title: Alberta Votes on Whether to Hold a Separation Referendum
articles.summary: People in the Canadian province of Alberta are voting on whether to hold a later vote on leaving Canada.

articles.title: Trump Plans to Close and Rebuild a Public Golf Course in Washington
articles.summary: President Trump says a public golf course near the White House will close for about 15 months for renovation, despite a court case.

articles.title: Food Aid Program Cuts Help for Families in Gaza
articles.summary: The World Food Programme says a lack of money is forcing it to help far fewer people in Gaza.
